name: Mapper 34 / BNROM / NINA-001

components: fixed 8 KiB CHR ROM or RAM
optional 8 KiB PRG RAM on documented extended boards
two independently switchable 4 KiB CHR-ROM windows
register decode over PRG RAM at $7FFD-$7FFF

connections: BNROM: Cpu.Data[0..1] AND currently-driven PrgRom.Data[0..1] -> prg.BankLatch[0..1]
NINA-001: Cpu.Write $7FFD & Cpu.M2.falling -> prg.BankLatch[0] and PrgRam[$7FFD]
NINA-001: Cpu.Write $7FFE & Cpu.M2.falling -> chr.Bank0[0..3] and PrgRam[$7FFE]
NINA-001: Cpu.Write $7FFF & Cpu.M2.falling -> chr.Bank1[0..3] and PrgRam[$7FFF]
notes: Mapper 34 intentionally resolves to one of two unrelated physical boards. NES 2.0 submapper 1 selects NINA-001/002; submapper 2 selects BNROM/I-IM. Legacy/submapper-0 images use CHR geometry to choose the fitted circuit: more than 8 KiB CHR ROM selects NINA-001, otherwise BNROM. Both variants retain fixed header-selected H/V CIRAM wiring and have no IRQ.
